_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit that copy -- config.json is gitignored, this example isn't. Every field here is optional: case_guide.py has a built-in default for all of them, and every one can also be set with a command-line flag (which wins over this file). Run `python case_guide.py -h` to see them.

azure_devops._comment: Same PAT/env-var as case-brief -- see case-brief/README.md for how to create one. project: leave null to search every project in the org. Skip this whole block (or pass --skip-ado) to use only what's already in the brief. style_pr_sample: how many of the project's other recent completed PRs to hand claude as a convention reference (branch/review/naming patterns) -- 0 disables, or pass --no-style-prs for one run.

claude._comment: model: null uses claude's own default. extra_args: raw flags passed through to the claude CLI, e.g. ["--permission-mode", "default"] if you ever hit a permission prompt -- left empty by default since the prompt is pure text generation and shouldn't need one (a one-off run without them: --no-claude-extra-args). max_ado_detail_chars: caps the live Azure DevOps detail block so a case with a lot of related activity can't inline an unbounded amount of it into the prompt -- set to 0/null to disable. agent: the project-scoped .claude/agents/<name>.md Claude Code agent to run the call as -- null/empty (or --no-agent) falls back to claude's plain default persona. example_count: how many previous guides to include as a house-style example -- 0 disables, or pass --no-example. max_example_chars: same truncation idea as max_ado_detail_chars, for the house-style example block.
